name: Chapter 0 Group Test

source._what: NOT pulled from the live course. Chapter 0 is this book's own chapter and course 340140 has no Chapter 0 Group Test to pull -- it only has the Chapter 0 Group Quiz (aid 23498445). This manifest is composed from the Chapter 0 homework pool, assignments 0.1-0.5 (aids 23993504 .. and siblings in books/integrated-math-1/hw/), so every qid below is a MyOpenMath shared-library qsetid that is ALREADY attached to a pushed Chapter 0 homework. Attach by qsetid; file nothing, copy nothing.

_pushed: Pushed into the Global Question Class 334437 on 2026-09-02, block 0-3-3-1 "Chapter 0: Foundations", gradebook category GROUP, undated (sdatetype=0 / edatetype=2000000000). Created with copyfrom=23258795 (the hw template, which presets.group also points at) and copydates unchecked. NOTHING WAS FILED: every question is a MyOpenMath shared-library qsetid already attached to a pushed Chapter 0 homework, so all 41 went in by the step-3 attach GET and a defect in one is a library defect, not a push defect. Question groups were rebuilt with groupSelected() highest-index-first and persisted with submitChanges(). Points were NOT set per question -- itemarray[i][4] read 9999 ("use assessment default") and defpts is 1, which is exactly the intent, so the points pass was skipped rather than replayed. READ BACK on a fresh navigation: 39 questions, 14 groups, 15 points; Teacher Preview rendered 16 questions (one per group-select), header "Score: 0/16", zero Eeek!, zero marker leaks, every question carrying its answer widget, confirmed visually on a full-page capture. TRIMMED 2026-09-02 to the 15-item group-test cap (Steve): the old Q2 (order of operations, single value -- qsetids 266918 / 270702) was removed with the page's own removegrp(), because Q1 already drills the same skill as a 3-part chain. Removing from an assessment removes the INSTANCE only; both qsetids remain in MOM's shared library and stay attached to 0.1 homework. SETTINGS also brought onto the documented Group Test profile the same day: defattempts=3, defregens=1 (was 20), read back fresh. Q11 SWAPPED 2026-09-02 (Steve): the commutative/associative bundle (274963 / 336030 / 274965 -- 'given ax+by, evaluate by+ax') came out and the abstract multiply-a-fraction-by-its-denominator bundle (333581 / 333585 / 333586) went in, a skill nothing else on the test touched. An attach APPENDS, so the new bundle is the LAST scored item rather than slot 11; that was accepted rather than reordered, because 0.5 already occupies the tail so the item stays inside its own section. The three removed qsetids stay in the shared library and remain attached to 0.5 homework.
_scope: Chapter 0 Foundations, sections 0.1-0.5. Deliberately does NOT re-run the Chapter 0 Group Quiz: the quiz leans on 0.3 and 0.5 (translating, absolute value, a(bx+c), graphing a/n, dividing fractions). This test spreads across all five sections and picks different variants of the skills the two share. Sized to 15 scored items, matching every deliberately-authored group test in the repo (Applied Finite W1-5, IM3 ch1, IM3 ch7, Intro to Stats HS ch1 are all 15; IM3's unit-7 quizzes are 14). The pulled IM1 chapter tests are NOT a guide -- ch6 reads as 1 scored item because all 20 of its questions sit in a single group, a defect recorded in MAP-IM1-GLOBAL.md.
_not_verified: The 16 questions were RENDERED and looked at, not ANSWERED. mom-transfer asks for every question to be filled, submitted and seen graded; that was not done here. The gate exists to catch filing defects (empty CodeMirror, wrong qtype, truncation) and none of those can occur on a push that files nothing -- but a bad answer key in one of MOM's shared questions would still be invisible. These are the same qsetids Steve already assigns as Chapter 0 homework. Not repairable from here either: with no file_path there is no source in this repo to fix and re-push.
